verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs say you can always export your notes to an open format such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder repeats this on HN as a deliberate answer to lock-in concerns. That covers the core of the switcher's exit path. The API cannot serve note contents because of end-to-end encryption, so export relies on the in-app feature. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the export procedure and its completeness (attachments/images, backlinks, tags, daily notes), and independent hands-on confirmation that a full knowledge-base export works.
